title.zh: 【StarkWare 推出 OffMarket，支持 Polymarket 用户进行隐私交易】
title.en: 【StarkWare 推出 OffMarket，支持 Polymarket 用户进行隐私交易】

current_state.zh: OffMarket 已向公众开放，允许 Polymarket 用户通过 Starknet 上的非托管零知识隐私池隐匿仓位与账户关联，每账户存款上限 1000 USDC，合约经审计和形式化验证，池规模约 150 万美元/1.7 万笔存款；非 Polymarket 官方产品，属 Builder 计划，有地理限制和美国用户禁令。
current_state.en: OffMarket is open to the public, allowing Polymarket users to obscure the link between positions and accounts via a non-custodial zero-knowledge privacy pool on Starknet, with a 1,000 USDC per-account deposit cap, audited and formally verified contracts, and a pool size of about $1.5M / 17k deposits; it is not an official Polymarket product, part of the Builder program, and subject to geographic restrictions including a U.S. ban.

updates.what_changed_zh: StarkWare推出OffMarket，这是一项非托管隐私服务，允许Polymarket用户在不公开将其持仓与账户关联的情况下进行交易，初期每个账户上限为1000 USDC。
updates.what_changed_en: StarkWare launched OffMarket, a non-custodial privacy service that lets Polymarket users trade without publicly linking their holdings to their accounts, initially capped at 1000 USDC per account.

updates.title_zh: StarkWare支持Polymarket用户隐匿下单，新推出OffMarket
updates.title_en: StarkWare支持Polymarket用户隐匿下单，新推出OffMarket
updates.what_changed_zh: OffMarket 已向公众开放（此前自8月起小范围试用），基于 Starknet 零知识共享隐私池；合约经 OpenZeppelin 审计并完成形式化验证；目前每账户存款上限 1000 USDC，池内约 150 万美元、1.7 万笔存款；服务非 Polymarket 官方产品，属其验证 Builder 计划，沿用地理限制包括禁止美国用户；独立合规机构 Financial Privacy Inc. 保管主查看密钥用于制裁筛查及合法披露。
updates.what_changed_en: OffMarket is now open to the public (following a limited trial since August), based on a Starknet zero-knowledge shared privacy pool; contracts audited by OpenZeppelin and formally verified; current deposit cap of 1,000 USDC per account, with about $1.5M and 17k deposits in the pool; not an official Polymarket product, part of its verified Builder program, subject to geographic restrictions including a U.S. ban; independent compliance firm Financial Privacy Inc. holds the master viewing key for sanctions screening and lawful disclosure.
updates.current_state_zh: OffMarket 已向公众开放，允许 Polymarket 用户通过 Starknet 上的非托管零知识隐私池隐匿仓位与账户关联，每账户存款上限 1000 USDC，合约经审计和形式化验证，池规模约 150 万美元/1.7 万笔存款；非 Polymarket 官方产品，属 Builder 计划，有地理限制和美国用户禁令。
updates.current_state_en: OffMarket is open to the public, allowing Polymarket users to obscure the link between positions and accounts via a non-custodial zero-knowledge privacy pool on Starknet, with a 1,000 USDC per-account deposit cap, audited and formally verified contracts, and a pool size of about $1.5M / 17k deposits; it is not an official Polymarket product, part of the Builder program, and subject to geographic restrictions including a U.S. ban.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: StarkWare opened its OffMarket privacy service to the public, letting Polymarket users trade via a non-custodial zero-knowledge pool on Starknet that obscures the link between positions and existing accounts, under a 1,000 USDC per-account deposit cap with OpenZeppelin-audited and formally verified contracts.
updates.detailed_summary_en: StarkWare opened its OffMarket privacy service to the public, letting Polymarket users trade via a non-custodial zero-knowledge pool on Starknet that obscures the link between positions and existing accounts, under a 1,000 USDC per-account deposit cap with OpenZeppelin-audited and formally verified contracts.
